name: Artem
site: bayernwerk.de · Energy and grid services, Bavaria
headline: Turn Bayernwerk’s usage data into contracts that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells energy solutions to private households, businesses and municipalities in the same way, with the same promotions and discounts for every visitor, whether they come for heat and cold or electromobility.

Once a customer logs into their account, their meter readings, contract and service usage are the strongest signal you have for the next offer and the next cancellation. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.

Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The household about to switch provider this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none, and the business customer planning a charging project gets a generic mail.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the switch before it happens
cases.text: Per customer, an AI reads meter readings, contract dates and service contacts to spot who is about to leave. It picks the offer, channel and moment for each customer.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the right add-on per customer
cases.text: For households, the AI matches electromobility or heat and cold offers to what each customer uses. For businesses and municipalities, it times the offer to their project, not the calendar.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every customer in the portal
cases.text: Personal nudges in the customer account and by email, based on meter readings and usage, give each customer a reason to log in again. Chosen per customer, not per segment.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
